t2.title: It important to preserve old buildings or should cities build new…
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is it important to preserve old buildings or should cities build new modern structures?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Cities worldwide face decisions about whether to preserve historic buildings or construct modern structures. I believe a balanced approach is essential.

Firstly, old buildings represent our cultural heritage and identity. They tell stories of previous generations and attract tourists who contribute to the local economy. Cities like Rome and Prague thrive because of their historic architecture.

Secondly, preserving buildings is often more environmentally sustainable than demolishing and rebuilding. Restoration uses fewer resources and produces less waste than new construction.

However, cities must also evolve. Modern buildings can be more energy-efficient and better suited to contemporary needs. Not all old buildings have historical significance, and some areas need development to accommodate growing populations.

The ideal solution combines preservation and progress. Significant landmarks should be protected, while new developments can incorporate modern design sensitively alongside historic areas.

In conclusion, cities should preserve buildings with cultural value while allowing thoughtful modernization. History and progress can coexist harmoniously with good planning.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
Cinema good. Seats nice. Sound good. I like films. New buildings good too. Bye.
t2.sampleA2:
Hello!
I went to the cinema. It is new. The seats are good and the sound is good too. I like old buildings but new buildings are good because they are modern. Old buildings are important because they are old. But sometimes we need new buildings. Thank you!
t2.sampleB1:
In my opinion, it's important to keep some old buildings. They are part of our history and they look nice. For example, old castles are very interesting.

However, I also think new buildings are important. We need new houses and offices. New buildings can be more comfortable and have better technology.

Maybe we can keep some old buildings and build new ones too. That would be a good idea, I think. It's good to have both.
t2.sampleB2: Should We Save the Past or Build the Future? Walk through any old city and you'll feel history in every brick — but should we cling to these ageing buildings, or make way for sleek modern structures? In my view, the smartest cities do a bit of both. There's no denying that old buildings are worth protecting. They are a living link to the past, and they give a place its character. Tourists flock to cities like Samarkand precisely because of their stunning historic architecture, which brings in money and jobs. On top of that, restoring an old building is often greener than knocking it down and starting from scratch. That said, cities cannot afford to stand still. As populations grow, we need modern, energy-efficient buildings that are cheaper to run and fit for everyday life. Not every old structure is a treasure worth saving, and outdated infrastructure sometimes simply has to go. The trick, then, is to strike a balance. Genuine landmarks should be preserved, while new developments spring up thoughtfully around them. All in all, history and progress needn't clash. With careful planning, cities can honour their roots and still move forward.
t2.uzSample:
Butun dunyo bo'ylab shaharlar tarixiy binolarni saqlab qolish yoki zamonaviy inshootlar qurish haqida qarorlar qabul qilishga duch kelmoqda. Men muvozanatli yondashuv muhim, deb hisoblayman.

Birinchidan, eski binolar bizning madaniy merosimiz va o'zligimizni ifodalaydi. Ular avvalgi avlodlar haqida hikoya qiladi va mahalliy iqtisodiyotga hissa qo'shadigan sayyohlarni jalb qiladi. Rim va Praga kabi shaharlar o'zlarining tarixiy arxitekturasi tufayli gullab-yashnamoqda.

Ikkinchidan, binolarni saqlab qolish ko'pincha buzib tashlash va qayta qurishdan ko'ra ekologik jihatdan barqarorroqdir. Ta'mirlash yangi qurilishga qaraganda kamroq resurslardan foydalanadi va kamroq chiqindi hosil qiladi.

Biroq, shaharlar ham rivojlanishi kerak. Zamonaviy binolar energiya jihatidan samaraliroq va zamonaviy ehtiyojlarga mosroq bo'lishi mumkin. Hamma eski binolar ham tarixiy ahamiyatga ega emas va ba'zi hududlar aholining o'sishini ta'minlash uchun rivojlanishga muhtoj.

Ideal yechim saqlash va taraqqiyotni birlashtiradi. Muhim diqqatga sazovor joylar himoya qilinishi kerak, yangi qurilishlar esa tarixiy hududlar bilan birga zamonaviy dizaynni sezgir tarzda o'z ichiga olishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, shaharlar madaniy qadriyatga ega bo'lgan binolarni saqlab qolishi va ayni paytda o'ylangan modernizatsiyaga ruxsat berishi kerak. Yaxshi rejalashtirish bilan tarix va taraqqiyot uyg'un tarzda birga yashashi mumkin.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Kino yaxshi. O'rindiqlar chiroyli. Ovoz yaxshi. Menga filmlar yoqadi. Yangi binolar ham yaxshi. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom!
Men kinoga bordim. U yangi. O'rindiqlari yaxshi va ovozi ham yaxshi. Menga eski binolar yoqadi, lekin yangi binolar yaxshi, chunki ular zamonaviy. Eski binolar muhim, chunki ular eski. Lekin ba'zida bizga yangi binolar kerak.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Mening fikrimcha, ba'zi eski binolarni saqlab qolish muhim. Ular bizning tariximizning bir qismi va ular chiroyli ko'rinadi. Masalan, eski qasrlar juda qiziqarli.

Biroq, men yangi binolar ham muhim deb o'ylayman. Bizga yangi uylar va ofislar kerak. Yangi binolar qulayroq bo'lishi va yaxshiroq texnologiyalarga ega bo'lishi mumkin.

Ehtimol, biz ba'zi eski binolarni saqlab qolishimiz va yangilarini ham qurishimiz mumkin. Bu yaxshi fikr bo'lardi, deb o'ylayman. Ikkalasining ham bo'lishi yaxshi.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Shaharlar uchun eski binolarni saqlab qolish yoki zamonaviy inshootlar qurish masalasi murakkab hisoblanadi. Zamonaviy rivojlanish zarur bo'lsa-da, menimcha, tarixiy binolarni saqlab qolish ham muhimdir.

Eski binolar o'tmish bilan aniq bog'lanishni ta'minlaydi. Ular avvalgi arxitektura uslublari va madaniy amaliyotlar haqida tushuncha beradi. Misol uchun, ko'plab Yevropa shaharlari o'zlarining tarixiy diqqatga sazovor joylari yaratadigan turizmga tayanadi. Bundan tashqari, mavjud binolarni moslashtirish ko'pincha buzib tashlash va qayta qurishdan ko'ra barqarorroq bo'lib, chiqindilar va energiya sarfini kamaytiradi.

Biroq, shaharlar ham rivojlanishi kerak. Zamonaviy binolar energiya jihatidan samaraliroq bo'lishi va o'sib borayotgan aholining ehtiyojlarini qondirish uchun mo'ljallangan bo'lishi mumkin. Eskirgan infratuzilmani almashtirish talab qilinishi mumkin. Asosiysi - muvozanatni topish. Saqlash bo'yicha harakatlar tarixiy ahamiyatga ega binolarga qaratilishi kerak, yangi qurilish esa mavjud shahar landshaftini to'ldirish uchun puxta rejalashtirilishi kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, saqlash va zamonaviy rivojlanishni birlashtirgan o'ylangan yondashuv jonli va barqaror shaharlarni yaratish uchun zarurdir.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the cinema management. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear StarScreen Management, Thank you for asking about my recent visit to your renovated cinema. I was thoroughly impressed with the upgrades. The reclining leather seats were exceptionally comfortable, and the surround sound quality was outstanding. The online booking system worked seamlessly, allowing me to choose exact seats. However, I noticed some areas for improvement. The snack prices are quite high compared to other cinemas. I would suggest introducing combo deals or a loyalty program for regular visitors. Additionally, the car park was completely full when I arrived. More parking spaces or partnerships with nearby car parks would be helpful. I would also love to see more independent films alongside blockbusters. Overall, the experience was excellent and I will certainly return. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Umarov
t12.sampleA1:
Hi StarScreen Cinema,

Cinema is good.
Seats are ok.
Sound is ok.
I like popcorn.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear StarScreen Cinema,

I went to your cinema. It was good. The seats were nice and the sound was good too. But the popcorn was expensive, and I didn't have enough money. I want cheaper popcorn because I like it very much. Thank you.

Bye,
Bekzod Umarov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear StarScreen Management,

Thank you for asking about my visit to the cinema. I liked the new seats; they were very comfortable. The sound was also very good, so I enjoyed the film.

However, I think the snacks are too expensive. Maybe you could make them a bit cheaper? Also, it was difficult to find a parking space when I arrived. It would be better if there were more spaces.

Overall, I had a good time, and I will probably come again.

Sincerely,
Bekzod Umarov
t12.sampleB2: Dear StarScreen Management, Thank you for inviting feedback on my recent visit to your newly renovated cinema. On the whole, I was highly impressed. The reclining leather seats were remarkably comfortable, and the surround sound made the film truly immersive. I was also pleased to find that the online booking system ran smoothly and let me pick my seats in advance. That said, there is still room for improvement. The snack prices struck me as rather steep, so introducing combo deals or a loyalty scheme would be greatly appreciated. In addition, the car park was full when I arrived, and extra parking spaces would make future visits far easier. Overall, my experience was a very positive one, and I will certainly be coming back. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli StarScreen rahbariyati,

Yaqinda yangilangan kinoteatringizga tashrifim haqida so‘raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Men yangilanishlardan juda ta’sirlandim. Yotib oladigan charm o‘rindiqlar juda qulay edi va atrofdagi ovoz sifati a’lo darajada edi. Onlayn bron qilish tizimi juda yaxshi ishladi va menga aniq o‘rindiqlarni tanlash imkonini berdi.

Biroq, men takomillashtirish uchun ba'zi sohalarni payqadim. Gazak narxlari boshqa kinoteatrlarga nisbatan ancha yuqori. Men muntazam tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun kombinatsiyalangan takliflar yoki sodiqlik dasturini joriy etishni taklif qilaman.

Bundan tashqari, men kelganimda avtoturargoh butunlay to'lgan edi. Ko'proq to'xtash joylari yoki yaqin atrofdagi avtoturargohlar bilan hamkorlik qilish foydali bo'lar edi. Men, shuningdek, blokbasterlar bilan bir qatorda ko'proq mustaqil filmlarni ko'rishni xohlardim.

Umuman olganda, tajriba juda yaxshi bo'ldi va men albatta qaytib kelaman.

Hurmat bilan,

Bekzod Umarov

Biroq, menimcha, gazaklar juda qimmat. Balki ularni biroz arzonroq qilishingiz mumkin? Shuningdek, men kelganimda mashina qo'yish joyini topish qiyin bo'ldi. Agar joylar ko'proq bo'lsa, yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

Hurmatli StarScreen rahbariyati,

Yaqinda yangilangan kinoteatringizda olgan taassurotlarim haqida fikr so‘raganingiz uchun rahmat. Aytishim kerakki, yaxshilanishlar juda sezilarli. O‘rindiqlarning qulayligi sezilarli darajada oshgan va ovoz tizimi filmdan umumiy zavqlanishimga ijobiy ta’sir ko‘rsatgan holda, to‘liq qamrab oluvchi tajriba taqdim etdi.

Biroq, mijozlar tajribasini yanada yaxshilashga yordam beradi deb hisoblagan bir nechta takliflarim bor. Birinchidan, bufetdagi narxlar mutanosib ravishda yuqori ko'rinadi. Narxlarni bosqichma-bosqich belgilash yoki reklama to‘plamlarini joriy etish ko‘proq mijozlarni ichimliklar sotib olishga jalb qilishda foydali bo‘lishi mumkin. Ikkinchidan, avtoturargohning mavjudligi tashvishga soldi. Ehtimol, valet xizmati kabi variantlarni o'rganish yoki yaqin atrofdagi avtoturargohlar bilan kelishuvga erishish bu muammoni hal qilishi mumkin.

Ushbu kichik kamchiliklarga qaramay, sizni yangilanishlar bilan tabriklayman va keyingi tashrifimni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Bekzod Umarov
